title: Window-scoped repo and surface registry
description: Mission Control should model the active cmux window explicitly: detect repos used by each workspace/surface, aggregate Beads from one or more repos, use ~/agents/histories for session logs, and persist a human-readable window registry under ~/data/mission-control/windows/<window-id>/ with workspace/surface JSON records.
acceptance_criteria: Refresh detects repo roots from workspace cwd and surface activity; single-repo workspaces show that repo's Beads; multi-repo workspaces aggregate Beads ordered by highlighted/current surface repo; session/history lookup uses and validates ~/agents/histories; registry schema is persisted under ~/data/mission-control/windows/<window-id>/ with clear workspace/surface JSON; tests and cargo build --release pass.
close_reason: Implemented window-scoped registry/backfill, histories validation/migration, multi-repo Beads ordering, bottom info IDs, and validated via tests/build/live cmux window.

title: Show Beads and conversation intent in workspace details
description: Update mission-control so workspace detail pages reflect the repo-wide Beads workflow and better summarize what each agent surface is doing. Replace or supersede the existing goals/progress section with a Beads-focused view where feasible, and make each surface bullet show both the overall conversation goal and the latest user ask summary. Use authoritative cmux/session/hook/event state where available.
acceptance_criteria: Detail view includes a Beads section sourced from repo-local bd data or tracked exports; goals/progress content is replaced or subordinated by Beads where requested; each surface row/bullet shows an overall goal line and a latest ask summary line; implementation is covered by focused tests and cargo build --release passes.
close_reason: Implemented Beads detail projection and per-surface conversation intent summaries; cargo test, release build, CLI smoke, and PTY TUI smoke passed.

title: Make Beads updates appear live in Mission Control
description: Newly created Beads tasks are not appearing on the Mission Control page in real time. Investigate the refresh/caching path for Beads data and update the TUI so repo-local Beads changes show up promptly without needing a restart or unrelated window refresh. Acceptance: creating or closing a Beads issue in a visible repo updates the Mission Control Beads section within the expected live refresh interval, with focused regression coverage.
close_reason: Implemented Beads-only live refresh every 5s with stale-generation protection, avoided full/Beads refresh overlap, sorted same-bucket issues by updated_at, isolated tests from real HOME writes, and validated with tests/release build/review.

title: Separate info layer from command footer
description: The bottom info layer currently mixes window/workspace/surface IDs with command education/help text. Move the info layer to its own stable line one row above the command footer so IDs are always readable and footer shortcuts remain separate.
